meta.name: resume-apply
meta.description: MUST USE this skill when ANY of these appear: (1) a JD or job posting is present — look for keywords like 채용, 채용공고, 주요업무, 자격요건, Requirements, Qualifications, 우대사항, 포지션; (2) user mentions applying to a specific company — '지원', '지원하려고', '지원 준비', '이력서 지원', 'resume apply', 'apply'; (3) user wants to tailor resume for a position — '이력서 맞춤', '이력서 준비', 'JD 이력서', 'JD 기반', 'JD 보고'; (4) user provides a JD via text, file path, or URL; (5) user mentions a company name with intent to apply (e.g. '토스 지원', '네이버 준비', '카카오 이력서'); (6) user wants to find or browse JDs — '어디 넣을까', '지원할 곳', 'JD 찾아', 'JD 골라', '공고 뭐 있지', '지원 준비 시작'. This skill handles the FULL workflow: acquire JD (provided or discovered from configured source) → create branch ({company}/{YYMMDD}) → tailor resume via review-resume → commit → generate PDF → deliver to configured output. Do NOT confuse with review-resume (general review without a target JD) or simple _config.yml edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据职位描述自动定制并投递简历
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次投递都需要根据JD手动修改简历
copy.tagline_en: Automatically tailor and submit resumes based on job descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to customize your resume for each job application

howto.what: 该技能会获取职位描述（JD），然后根据JD定制简历、生成PDF，并自动保存到您指定的位置。整个过程包括创建分支、调用审阅、修改配置文件等步骤。
howto.when: 当您提供职位描述（文字、文件或链接），或表达想申请某公司（如“支持简历定制”），或想让Claude帮忙查找职位时触发。

say.text: 帮我针对这个JD优化简历。
say.note: Claude会读取JD并启动定制流程。

say.text: 我想申请Naver的职位，有什么JD吗？
say.note: Claude会尝试发现JD并引导您选择。

say.text: 帮我找几个适合我的公司职位。
say.note: Claude会从配置的JD来源列出选项。

howto.what_en: This skill acquires a job description (JD), tailors the resume to match it, generates a PDF, and delivers it to a configured output path. It handles the full workflow: branch creation, review, commit, PDF generation, and cleanup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a JD (text, file, or URL), mentions applying to a specific company, or wants to browse available JDs from a configured source.

say_en.text: Customize my resume for this JD.
say_en.note: Claude reads the JD and starts the tailoring workflow.

say_en.text: I want to apply to Naver. Any JDs available?
say_en.note: Claude searches the JD source for relevant listings.

say_en.text: Find suitable job positions for me.
say_en.note: Claude presents available JDs from the configured source.
